item.title: Sonu Nigam leases Santacruz East office for ₹12.61 crore over five years
item.description: Playback singer Sonu Nigam has leased out a commercial property in Mumbai’s Santacruz East for five years at a cumulative rental value exceeding ₹12.61 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by SquareYards. The office space, located in the Trade Centre BKC building, spans 4,257 sq ft and was leased to Pattni Hospitality, the operator of Downtown 29 café and bar. item.description: Goa: The 2025–26 Indian Super League (ISL) season has been officially suspended after the All India Football Federation (AIFF) failed to secure a single bid for the league’s commercial rights.
